newsitem.title: USA: Plane crashes in Wisconsin, no fatalities.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Wisconsin, no fatalities.

text.p: A private airplane with 10 people on board crashed in a remote wooded area in northern Wisconsin Saturday, law enforcement officials said.
There were no fatalities and most of the passengers had been released from area hospitals Saturday night, hospital officials said.

The Kingair airplane was travelling from Moline, Ill., to Rhinelander, Wis., with a final stop scheduled in Eagle River, Wis., when it crashed Saturday morning, according to a news release from the Oneida, Wis., County Sheriff's office.
Investigators from the National Transportation Safety Board were on the scene Saturday night. No cause of the crash had been released.
